hook_line: NASDAQ TUMBLES 2.6% IN WORST DAY SINCE JUNE

hook_stat.sub: Nasdaq Composite fall on October 22, its steepest drop since June

stats.label: Brent crude settlement a barrel, up 3%

news_summary: The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.6% on October 22, its steepest drop since June, as oil surged and AI spending fears hit tech stocks.
payoff: The next test is whether oil holds above $110.
